text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty autopage triggered — inference-gateway-usw2 high 5xx rate. 1m error rate = 12% (threshold 5%). Trigger: autopage/inference-high-5xx. Paging on-call.

oncall_jane: Acked. I'm on it, checking dashboards and logs.

michael_sre: +1, reachable. I'll help triage kvcache + ingress.

dashbot: Grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/internal/dashboard?panel=5 — errors concentrated on svc=inference-router-usw2-canary, spike started ~3m ago.

oncall_jane: doing a quick smoke curl against a canary route to reproduce.

oncall_jane: ```
$ for i in {1..5}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.redwood.test/v1/health; sleep 0.5; done
502
502
200
502
502
```

michael_sre: logs show upstream read timeouts and some grpc connect resets. kvcache miss rate spiking in prometheus (kvcache_miss_rate ~ 18%). Could be cache eviction / hot-key storm.

kevin_platform: I'll preemptively restart the canary router pods to clear any stale state: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-router-canary -n prod-usw2` — doing a staggered restart (30s between pods).

marta-support: PS — support queue: ~30 customers affected, ~6 high-priority. Acme Corp reports failures on embeddings calls (request id examples: req_3f9a, req_3fa0). Let me know when we have a mitigation to tell customers.

oncall_jane: diverting traffic away from canary via maestro: setting canary weight -> 0.1 (was 0.4). Applying now.

ops-bot: Runbook: Inference autopage response — https://runbooks.redwood/infra/inference-autopage. Play: reduce canary weight, restart router pods, warmup caches, scale router replicas.

michael_sre: scaling canary pool from 4 -> 8 replicas to give capacity while we stabilize. `kubectl scale deploy/inference-router-canary --replicas=8 -n prod-usw2`

oncall_jane: :hourglass_flowing_sand: watching error rate and kvcache miss rate. will check back in 5m.

incident-bot: Metric update — inference-gateway-usw2 1m 5xx rate = 4.1% (was 12%). Alert auto-suppress will stop if <5% for 10m.

oncall_jane: :white_check_mark: error rate dropping, kvcache miss rate decreasing to ~6%. Keeping scaled replicas and low canary weight for 30m to avoid flare.

marta-support: Notifying impacted customers with interim update: "We observed an elevated error rate earlier; traffic has been rerouted and we are monitoring. Support team will follow up with detailed timeline."

oncall_jane: Handing off to michael_sre to lead stabilization + postmortem. Handoff at 15:00 UTC. If anything spikes, ping me directly.

michael_sre: Ack handoff. I'll gather logs/traces, save kv metrics, and start a brief RCA. Will loop in storage infra if kvcache evictions persist.

oncall_jane: Thanks all — closing active page for now. Will re-open if rate goes above threshold. :lock_with_ink_pen:
